response.sql: SELECT AVG(media_avg) AS value FROM (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS media_avg FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name) AS averages;

assumptions.assumption: Passing the file-size cutoff means exceeding 10,323,804 bytes; the request does not specify whether the boundary is inclusive.

alternatives.interpretation: Tracks exactly at the cutoff also pass.
